'sentence' quotes the doc text verbatim (runs of whitespace collapsed, markdown kept), so connectors such as so, because, only, all, every, never and except stay visible. 'source' is one or more anchors joined by ' ;; '. Anchor forms: 'path:line:snippet' (the snippet appears on that line of that file); 'E path' (the file exists); 'N regex|path|ext|count' (the number of lines matching the regex under path, for files of that extension, equals count; an absence claim has count 0); 'V path:from:to:text' (the lines, with their '> ' marker removed, equal the text); 'R text' (a measurement or command the builder ran on 2026-10-19, not re-checkable by script); 'X reason' (not a repo-checkable fact: a label, a framing sentence, a judgement or a citation of a spec section). Each source file was read on its own with grep -n or a numbered single-file read; no multi-file listing and no unnumbered slice was used.
